title: LOOSE LIMBS
subtitle: SUNDAY MOBILITY. STILL BARKED. JOINTS FIRST. NO HIDING IN THE SOFA.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SUNDAY. LOOSE LIMBS. FOURTEEN MINUTES. MOBILITY DAY. STILL BARKED. WE OIL THE HINGES. YOU DO NOT GET A LIE-IN FROM ME.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. LOOSE LIMBS DONE. YOU SHOWED UP ON A SUNDAY. THAT IS DISCIPLINE. SEE YOU TOMORROW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: FEET FLAT. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEELS. SQUEEZE AT THE TOP. SLOW LOWER. OPEN THE HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGE. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SLOW. HEELS DOWN. SQUEEZE THE TOP. THIS OPENS THE HIPS YOU SIT ON ALL WEEK. DO NOT RUSH IT, YOU LAZY SOD.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. KEEP THE HIPS QUIET. STAY OFF THE SOFA.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: LOW BACK FLAT ON THE FLOOR. SLOW OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. POSTURE DRILL. NO RUSH.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. BACK FLAT. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR POSTURE DRILL. FIX THE DESK HUNCH. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE BACK QUIET.

exercises.name: CHAIR SIT-TO-STAND
exercises.cue: STURDY CHAIR BEHIND YOU. LIGHT TOUCH THEN STAND. CHEST UP. KNEES TRACK THE TOES. ANKLES AND HIPS MOVE.
exercises.speakStart: CHAIR SIT-TO-STAND. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. LIGHT TOUCH ON THE SEAT. STAND CLEAN. CHEST UP. THIS IS HIP AND ANKLE MOBILITY. NO PLONKING.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. DO NOT SIT FOR REAL.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. TOUCH THE CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FOUR EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. OWN THE WOBBLE.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS
exercises.cue: STAIR OR STURDY STEP. DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. LIGHT HAND ON A WALL IF YOU WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP. STAND TALL. WALL FOR BALANCE IF YOU NEED IT. MORE BALANCE. DO NOT RUSH.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
